title: aim
description: What the orchestrator gives `steering aim` on stdin, for it to take into the steering: the work's opportunity solution tree whole as the orchestrator weighed it, and, where it settled them, the issues of the work and the steps to the target.

message.description: What the weighing changed and why, in one sentence, for the commit's message.

steps.description: The way to the target, first to last, each deliverable that the user sees once made in a step of its own before what rests on it, then the walking skeleton. A step or a deliverable that the steering already holds keeps its status.

next.description: Where the weighing decides what the deliverable takes next: generator, to make it again on what was weighed, within LIMIT judged Rounds; anew, to make it again from its first Round, as the solution it was made on changed; fixer, to mend it; refactorer, to refactor it; done, to end it. Absent, it goes on as the steering holds it.
